risk_if_not_implemented: Without Media & Data Retention, data may be retained longer than authorized or necessary, or may be unrecoverable when legally or operationally required. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Retention / Inability to Dispose of Data (R-AM-3), Data Loss / Integrity Compromise (R-BC-2), Contractual Default / Termination (R-EX-2), Regulatory / Legal / Contractual Financial Liability (R-EX-5), Loss of Investigative / Evidentiary Capability (R-IR-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11).

compensating_control_1.name: Digital Media Sanitization
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to sanitize digital media with the strength and integrity commensurate with the classification or sensitivity of the information prior to disposal, release out of organizational control or release for reuse.
compensating_control_1.justification: Digital Media Sanitization (DCH-27) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Media & Data Retention (DCH-27) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Data applicability. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Event Log & Security-Relevant Telemetry Retention
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to retain event logs and security-relevant telemetry for a time period consistent with records retention requirements to provide support for after-the-fact investigations of security incidents and to meet statutory, regulatory and contractual retention requirements.
compensating_control_2.justification: Event Log & Security-Relevant Telemetry Retention (MON-13) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Media & Data Retention (DCH-27) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
